title: Agent Decision Record (AgDR) frontmatter
description: Normative schema for the YAML frontmatter of an Agent Decision Record. See SPEC.md for the full normative reference, including body-section requirements this schema cannot express.

id.description: Zero-padded identifier, e.g. AgDR-0001. MUST match the file's name (see SPEC.md § Naming Convention).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with time and timezone, e.g. 2026-01-30T18:45:00Z.

agent.description: Identifier for the AI agent that made the decision, e.g. claude-code, codex, copilot, cursor, windsurf.

model.description: Model identifier, e.g. claude-opus-4-5-20251101. Use the {model-id} placeholder in illustrative docs; real AgDRs SHOULD record the actual model in use at decision time.

supersedes.description: Optional ID of the AgDR this one replaces.
